message.content:
We need
\[
617n \equiv 943n \pmod{18}.
\]
Subtract \(617n\) from both sides:
\[
943n-617n \equiv 0 \pmod{18}.
\]
\[
326n \equiv 0 \pmod{18}.
\]
Now reduce \(326\) modulo \(18\):
\[
326 \div 18 = 18 \text{ remainder } 2,
\]
so
\[
2n \equiv 0 \pmod{18}.
\]
This means
\[
18 \mid 2n,
\]
which simplifies to
\[
9 \mid n.
\]
The smallest positive integer \(n\) divisible by \(9\) is
\[
n=9.
\]

The answer is 9.
